entries.subject: DESI Legacy Imaging Surveys DR10 color HiPS
entries.finding: A 2200 x 2200 px hips2fits cutout of CDS/P/DESI-Legacy-Surveys/DR10/color, 9.3 arcmin wide on the 2MASS position. The two bright stars 8 and 10 arcmin away fall outside it; the ghost of one reddens the north-east corner.

entries.subject: DSS2, Pan-STARRS DR1 and SkyMapper color HiPS
entries.finding: Looked at as 900 px previews of the same field on 2026-10-02. DSS2 is photographic and shallower, SkyMapper is shallower, and Pan-STARRS at declination -27.5 is at the edge of its coverage and subtracts the galaxies' own light as sky.

entries.subject: ESO archive imaging (VLT/FORS1 V band, ESO/MPI 2.2 m WFI)
entries.finding: The images Arnaboldi et al. fitted. Not used: the lab recipe reads a published display image by URL, and these are calibrated FITS frames that need a stated display transfer and a local-input route.
entries.revisitWhen: The lab recipe can read a prepared local image.

entries.subject: Spheroid
entries.finding: Arnaboldi et al.'s (2012) Table 2 'allmask' fit (n = 4.8, r_e = 198.8 arcsec, axis ratio 0.93, position angle 32) is used as published; no fit was made here. Their 'cmask' fit (n = 5.0, 270.6 arcsec) leaves the north-east excess in and over-predicts the south-west; their maximal symmetric model (n = 10.5, 850 arcsec) is a one-sided profile fit. Barbosa et al. (2018) describe the same light with four components, which the lab's isophote fill cannot read.

entries.subject: The neighbour NGC 3309
entries.finding: Masked and filled from NGC 3311's isophotes, not drawn. Five mask radii were tried: three D25 radii covers the whole galaxy; one D25 radius (125 arcsec) covers NGC 3311's core, where the isophote fill has nothing to read and left a hole; half the distance (52 arcsec) left NGC 3309's outer light as a ring around a dark disc; 77 arcsec left a bright arc; 95 arcsec leaves a fainter arc farther out and is used. A second spheroid for NGC 3309 from Arnaboldi et al.'s Table 1 needs the lab to condition one image on two components.
entries.revisitWhen: The lab can share an image between two spheroids.

entries.subject: Catalogue for the neighbour masks
entries.finding: HyperLEDA PGC (Paturel et al. 2003) lists 125 galaxies (types G and GM) with a D25 within 0.5 degrees; the 16 whose masks reach the cutout are masked. Type GM is needed: PGC 31476, 120 arcsec south, is one.

entries.subject: Globular cluster and compact object catalogues
entries.finding: Wehner et al. (2008) publish no cluster positions at CDS. Misgeld et al. (2011), CDS J/A+A/531/A4 tablea1, lists 118 globular clusters and ultra-compact dwarfs of the Hydra I core with positions and velocities. Not drawn: a volume bank's dots are switched on by a table in the site's runtime code, which this change does not touch.
entries.revisitWhen: The dots of a volume bank are declared in its package.
